title: You Need Better Attention Priors
author: Elon Litman; Gabe Guo
summary: This paper shows that standard attention works like a transport problem with a uniform prior, which limits its flexibility. The authors propose GOAT, a new method that learns better, structured priors to improve attention stability and control. Their approach explains and improves positional encodings by framing them as learned priors rather than fixed heuristics.
